subproblems.title: Compact distance sublevel sets around a compact subset of an open set
subproblems.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let C ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and nonempty with C ⊆ U. Then there is δ₀ > 0 such that for every real r ≤ δ₀ the sublevel set {x ∈ ℝ^P : dist(x, C) ≤ r} of the distance function dist(x, C) = Metric.infDist x C is compact and contained in U.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → C.Nonempty → ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ δ₀ → IsCompact {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ∧ {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ⊆ U

The parent applies it with C := closure(W) and then works with δ := δ₀/3, so every sublevel set {g ≤ r} it uses (r = 5δ/2 and r = s < 2δ, both ≤ δ₀) is compact and lies in U.

1. (Choice of δ₀.) C is compact, U is open and C ⊆ U. By Mathlib IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open there is δ₀ > 0 with cthickening(δ₀, C) ⊆ U. Fix this δ₀.
2. Fix a real r ≤ δ₀ and put S := {x : dist(x, C) ≤ r}. (If r < 0 then S = ∅, and the argument below covers this case too.)
3. (S ⊆ cthickening(δ₀, C).) Let x ∈ S, so dist(x, C) ≤ r ≤ δ₀. Since C ≠ ∅, infEDist(x, C) ≠ ∞ (Metric.infEDist_ne_top). Hence infEDist(x, C) = ENNReal.ofReal((infEDist(x, C)).toReal) = ENNReal.ofReal(dist(x, C)) (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal). ENNReal.ofReal is monotone, so infEDist(x, C) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₀, that is, x ∈ cthickening(δ₀, C) (Metric.mem_cthickening_iff).
4. (S is closed.) The map x ↦ dist(x, C) is continuous (continuous_infDist_pt). So S, the set where it is ≤ the constant r, is closed (isClosed_le).
5. (S is compact.) ℝ^P is a proper metric space and C is compact, so cthickening(δ₀, C) is compact (IsCompact.cthickening). By steps 3 and 4, S is a closed subset of this compact set, hence compact (IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset).
6. (S ⊆ U.) By steps 3 and 1, S ⊆ cthickening(δ₀, C) ⊆ U.
7. Steps 5 and 6 hold for every real r ≤ δ₀. So δ₀ > 0 has the required property. ∎

subproblems.title: Integral data of an integer multiplicity representation
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents Z → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → R.measure K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable R.orient R.measure ∧ ((∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = ∫ x, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: facts (R1)-(R4) of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize, stated for one representation. The parent applies them to IMReps of T_j, of ∂T_j and of T. Parts (a)-(c) and (d) are exactly the hypotheses that (SL) requires of (μ, ξ) and of (μ', ξ').
Notation: ν := Hⁿ⌞M = μHE[n].restrict M. By definition (IMRep.measure), R.measure = ν.withDensity(x ↦ (θ(x) : [0, ∞])).
1. (Absolute continuity.) R.measure ≪ ν (Mathlib withDensity_absolutelyContinuous).
2. (a) Let K ⊆ U be compact. K is closed, hence Borel. By withDensity_apply, R.measure(K) = ∫⁻_K θ dν = ∫⁻ θ d(ν⌞K). Since K is measurable, ν⌞K = (μHE[n]⌞M)⌞K = μHE[n]⌞(K ∩ M) (Measure.restrict_restrict). As K ∩ M = M ∩ K, R.measure(K) = ∫⁻_{M ∩ K} θ dHⁿ. This is ≠ ∞ by the IMRep field locallyIntegrable_mult applied to K (K compact, K ⊆ U). Hence R.measure(K) < ∞.
3. (b) The IMRep field aestronglyMeasurable_orient says that ξ is ν-a.e. strongly measurable. By step 1 and AEStronglyMeasurable.mono_ac, ξ is R.measure-a.e. strongly measurable.
4. (c) Since R.measure ≪ ν, a property that holds for ν-a.e. x also holds for R.measure-a.e. x (Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.ae_le). Apply this to the property that |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every n-covector α.
5. (d) Fix ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) and put F(x) := ξ(x)(ω(x)) ∈ ℝ. Since R represents Z, Z(ω) = R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)F(x) dHⁿ(x) = ∫ θ(x)F(x) dν(x).
 The density x ↦ (θ(x) : [0, ∞]) equals x ↦ ((θ(x) : ℝ≥0) : [0, ∞]) (ENNReal.coe_natCast). The map x ↦ (θ(x) : ℝ≥0) is measurable: θ is measurable by the field measurable_mult, composed with the cast ℕ → ℝ≥0 (measurable_from_nat).
 Mathlib integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul gives ∫ F d(ν.withDensity θ) = ∫ θ(x) • F(x) dν(x). It needs no integrability assumption, since both sides are Bochner integrals. Also θ(x) • F(x) = (θ(x) : ℝ)·F(x) (NNReal.smul_def, NNReal.coe_natCast).
 Hence ∫ F dR.measure = ∫ θF dν = Z(ω). ∎

subproblems.title: Measure and action of the Borel restriction of an integer multiplicity representation
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) and R' be IMReps in U (IMRep U n), let A ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and let E ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set. Assume R' represents A, carrier(R') = M ∩ E, mult(R') = θ and orient(R') = ξ. Then R'.measure = R.measure⌞E (the restriction R.measure.restrict E), and A(ω) = ∫_E ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dR.measure(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), where ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ = ξ(x)(ω(x)).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R R' : IMRep U n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet E → R'.Represents A → R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E → R'.mult = R.mult → R'.orient = R.orient → R'.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, A ω = ∫ x in E, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: fact (R6) of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize. The parent obtains R' and A from the antecedent (IR) and then uses this formula for T⌞{g < s} (the current T'), for T_{φ(j)}⌞{g < s} (step 6) and for T⌞∅ (step 0).
Notation: ν := μHE[n] (= Hⁿ). θ also denotes the density x ↦ (θ(x) : [0, ∞]).
1. (Measures.) By definition (IMRep.measure), R.measure = (ν⌞M).withDensity θ. Using carrier(R') = M ∩ E and mult(R') = θ, R'.measure = (ν⌞(M ∩ E)).withDensity θ.
2. E is Borel, so Mathlib restrict_withDensity gives R.measure⌞E = ((ν⌞M).withDensity θ)⌞E = ((ν⌞M)⌞E).withDensity θ. Measure.restrict_restrict (E measurable) gives (ν⌞M)⌞E = ν⌞(E ∩ M) = ν⌞(M ∩ E). Comparing with step 1, R'.measure = R.measure⌞E.
3. (Action.) Apply part (d) of the sibling imrep_data to the current A and its representation R'. For every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), A(ω) = ∫ orient(R')(x)(ω(x)) dR'.measure(x). Substitute orient(R') = ξ and R'.measure = R.measure⌞E (step 2). This gives A(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) d(R.measure⌞E)(x) = ∫_E ξ(x)(ω(x)) dR.measure(x); the last equality is the definition of the set integral. ∎

restrict_withDensity and restrict_restrict give R.measure⌞E = (Hⁿ⌞(M∩E)).withDensity θ.

subproblems.title: Mass of a current given by integration against a measure with unit-bounded orientation
subproblems.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and X ∈ 𝒟_d(U). Let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P, let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_d(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P d), and let E, V ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets. Assume that for μ-a.e. x, |⟨α, ξ(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for every d-covector α (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α, ⟨α, ξ(x)⟩ = ξ(x)(α)). Assume also that X(ω) = ∫_E ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dμ(x) (Bochner integral) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U). Then M_V(X) = X.massOn V ≤ μ(E ∩ V).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (E V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = ∫ x in E, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ) → X.massOn V ≤ μ (E ∩ V)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the mass estimates of steps 0 and 8 of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize. These rest on (R3): if |ω| ≤ 1, then ∫_B⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ ≤ μ(B). Here the estimate is stated for an arbitrary integral current and an arbitrary region V. The parent uses it with X = A_{φ(j)}(s), E = {g < s}, V = U (M(T'_j) ≤ μ_{φ(j)}({g < s})), with X = B_{φ(j)}(s) (M(B) ≤ μ'_{φ(j)}({g < s})), and with μ = 0 for the zero current in step 0. The integral is the Bochner integral, which is 0 for non-integrable integrands, so no finiteness or integrability assumption is needed.
1. By definition, M_V(X) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) over the admissible ω: those ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U d V). Fix such an ω. It suffices (sSup_le) to show ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) ≤ μ(E ∩ V).
2. Put f(x) := ξ(x)(ω(x)) and S := tsupport ω, a closed (hence Borel) set with S ⊆ V. Then ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) = ENNReal.ofReal(∫_E f dμ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal|∫_E f dμ| = ‖∫_E f dμ‖ₑ (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs) ≤ ∫⁻_E ‖f‖ₑ dμ. The last inequality is Mathlib enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm, which holds for every f.
3. Claim: ‖f(x)‖ₑ ≤ 1_S(x) for μ⌞E-a.e. x. The hypothesis holds μ-a.e., hence μ⌞E-a.e. (ae_restrict_of_ae). If x ∈ S, then ‖f(x)‖ₑ = ENNReal.ofReal|ξ(x)(ω(x))| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal|ω(x)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 = 1, by the hypothesis with α := ω(x) and by admissibility. If x ∉ S, then ω(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport), so f(x) = ξ(x)(0) = 0.
4. By lintegral_mono_ae, ∫⁻_E ‖f‖ₑ dμ ≤ ∫⁻_E 1_S dμ = (μ⌞E)(S) = μ(S ∩ E), using lintegral_indicator_one and Measure.restrict_apply (S Borel). Since S ⊆ V, μ(S ∩ E) ≤ μ(E ∩ V) (measure_mono).
5. Combining steps 2-4, ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) ≤ μ(E ∩ V) for every admissible ω. Hence M_V(X) ≤ μ(E ∩ V). ∎

  apply sSup_le
  rintro r ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩
  show ENNReal.ofReal (X ω) ≤ _
  rw [hX ω]
  have hS : MeasurableSet (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) :=
    (isClosed_tsupport _).measurableSet

        ≤ ‖∫ x in E, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ‖ₑ := by
        rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]

a.e. on E, ‖⟨ω,ξ⟩‖ₑ ≤ 1_{tsupport ω}: the unit bound and |ω| ≤ 1 hold on the support, and ω = 0 off it.
∫⁻_E 1_{tsupport ω} dμ = μ(tsupport ω ∩ E) ≤ μ(E ∩ V); then take the supremum over ω.

subproblems.title: Subadditivity of local mass
subproblems.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^P, and let X, Y, Z ∈ 𝒟_d(U) satisfy X(ω) = Y(ω) + Z(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U). Then M_V(X) ≤ M_V(Y) + M_V(Z) in [0, ∞], where M_V = massOn V.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = Y ω + Z ω) → X.massOn V ≤ Y.massOn V + Z.massOn V
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize. There, for admissible η, ENNReal.ofReal(∂T'_j(η)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(B(η)) + ENNReal.ofReal(Z(η)) ≤ M(B) + M(Z). It is used with X = ∂A_{φ(j)}(s), Y = B_{φ(j)}(s), Z = ∂A_{φ(j)}(s) - B_{φ(j)}(s) and V = U.
1. M_V(X) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) over ω in the admissible set massAdmissibleOn U d V: tsupport ω ⊆ V and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. This set depends only on U, d and V, so it is the same for X, Y and Z. Fix an admissible ω.
2. ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) = ENNReal.ofReal(Y(ω) + Z(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Y(ω)) + ENNReal.ofReal(Z(ω)) (ENNReal.ofReal_add_le).
3. ω is admissible, so ENNReal.ofReal(Y(ω)) ≤ M_V(Y) and ENNReal.ofReal(Z(ω)) ≤ M_V(Z) (GeometricCurrentOn.le_massOn).
4. Hence ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) ≤ M_V(Y) + M_V(Z) for every admissible ω. Taking the supremum (sSup_le) gives M_V(X) ≤ M_V(Y) + M_V(Z). ∎

  apply sSup_le
  rintro r ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩
  show ENNReal.ofReal (X ω) ≤ _
  rw [h ω]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_add_le).trans (add_le_add (Y.le_massOn hω) (Z.le_massOn hω))

ofReal(Y ω + Z ω) ≤ ofReal(Y ω) + ofReal(Z ω) ≤ M_V(Y) + M_V(Z).
Take the supremum over ω.

subproblems.title: A current vanishing on forms supported away from a compact set has compact support inside it
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, K ⊆ U compact, and F ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with F(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) whose topological support is disjoint from K. Then spt F ⊆ K and spt F is compact. Here spt F = U ∖ Z(F) (GeometricCurrentOn.support), Z(F) being the union of all open W with closure(W) compact, closure(W) ⊆ U and F(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (F : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) K → F ω = 0) → F.support ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact F.support
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 7 of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize, with K = {g ≤ s}, and step 0 with K = ∅. This is the already accepted declaration rsd_cmr_support_subset_of_vanish, reused with its identical frozen type. Its accepted proof, which isolates the support argument for an arbitrary current F, is:
1. Points of U ∖ K are not in spt F. Let y ∈ U ∖ K. U is open and K is closed (compact), so U ∖ K is open (IsOpen.sdiff), and there is s > 0 with B_s(y) ⊆ U ∖ K. Put W := B_{s/2}(y).
 (a) W is open and y ∈ W.
 (b) closure(W) ⊆ B̄_{s/2}(y) ⊆ B_s(y) ⊆ U ∖ K ⊆ U.
 (c) closure(W) is compact, as a closed subset of the compact closed ball B̄_{s/2}(y) (ℝ^P is proper).
 (d) If ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) and tsupport ω ⊆ W, then tsupport ω ⊆ B_s(y) ⊆ U ∖ K is disjoint from K, so F(ω) = 0.
 By (a)-(d), W is one of the sets whose union is Z(F). So y ∈ Z(F) and y ∉ spt F.
2. spt F ⊆ K. By definition spt F ⊆ U, and by step 1 no point of U ∖ K lies in spt F.
3. Compactness. From spt F = U ∖ Z(F), spt F ⊆ K and K ⊆ U we get spt F = K ∖ Z(F). Z(F) is open, as a union of open sets (isOpen_zeroRegion). So K ∖ Z(F) is a closed subset of the compact set K, hence compact (IsCompact.diff). ∎
proof_key_steps: For y ∈ U ∖ K, a ball B_{s/2}(y) with closure in U ∖ K is a relatively compact zero set of F, so y ∉ spt F.
Hence spt F ⊆ K, and spt F = K ∖ Z(F) is compact because Z(F) is open.

subproblems.title: Weak convergence of sublevel restrictions without mass concentration at the cut level
subproblems.statement:
Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, g : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous, s ∈ ℝ and G := {x : g(x) < s}.
Let μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) and μ be measures on the Borel sets of ℝ^P with μ_j(G) < ∞ and μ(G) < ∞.
Let ξ_j, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_d(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P d) be μ_j- resp. μ-a.e. strongly measurable, with |⟨α, ξ_j(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for μ_j-a.e. x and |⟨α, ξ(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x, for every d-covector α (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α, ⟨α, ζ⟩ = ζ(α)).
Let T_j, T'_j, T, T' ∈ 𝒟_d(U) satisfy, for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U): T_j(ω) = ∫⟨ω(x), ξ_j(x)⟩ dμ_j(x), T(ω) = ∫⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dμ(x), T'_j(ω) = ∫_G⟨ω(x), ξ_j(x)⟩ dμ_j(x) and T'(ω) = ∫_G⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dμ(x).
Assume T_j ⇀ T in U (WeaklyConvergesOn), and that for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is δ > 0 with μ_j({s - δ ≤ g ≤ s}) ≤ ε for all sufficiently large j.
Then T'_j ⇀ T' in U.

subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 10 (weak convergence) of the parent proof of cmc_fc_localize, stated abstractly. In the parent: g = dist(·, closure W); s is the good level from cmc_fc_good_slice; μ_j = R_{φ(j)}.measure and ξ_j = R_{φ(j)}.orient; T_j = T_{φ(j)}; T'_j = A_{φ(j)}(s), the slice current T_{φ(j)}⌞{g < s}; μ = R_T.measure, ξ = R_T.orient and T' = T⌞{g < s}. The no-concentration hypothesis (H6) is conclusion (ii) of good_slice transported along g.
Notation: G := {g < s}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; ⟨β, ζ⟩ := ζ(β).
Hypotheses:
(H0) g is continuous.
(H1) μ_j(G) < ∞ for all j, and μ(G) < ∞.
(H2) ξ_j is μ_j-a.e. strongly measurable, and ξ is μ-a.e. strongly measurable.
(H3) For μ_j-a.e. x, |⟨α, ξ_j(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for all α; likewise for μ-a.e. x and ξ.
(H4) For every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) (Bochner integrals): T_j(ω) = ∫⟨ω, ξ_j⟩ dμ_j, T(ω) = ∫⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ, T'_j(ω) = ∫_G⟨ω, ξ_j⟩ dμ_j, T'(ω) = ∫_G⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ.
(H5) T_j ⇀ T.
(H6) For every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is δ > 0 such that μ_j({s - δ ≤ g ≤ s}) ≤ ε for all sufficiently large j.
Claim: T'_j(ω) → T'(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U).
1. (A bound for ω.) Fix ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U); ω also denotes the underlying smooth compactly supported form. The coefficient norm is |α| = sqrt(Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(1)}, …, e_{I(d)})²). It is continuous in α: each evaluation α ↦ α(v) at a fixed tuple v is continuous (continuous_eval_const), and squares, finite sums and sqrt are continuous. So x ↦ |ω(x)| is continuous. It has compact support because ω does and |0| = 0 (HasCompactSupport.comp_left). Hence it is bounded (HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous). Fix c ∈ ℝ with |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x; then c ≥ |ω(0)| ≥ 0.
2. (Cutoff estimate.) Claim: let ν be a measure on ℝ^P with ν(G) < ∞, and ζ a ν-a.e. strongly measurable d-vector field with |⟨α, ζ(x)⟩| ≤ |α| for all α, for ν-a.e. x. Let r ∈ ℝ, and let χ : ℝ^P → [0, 1] be continuous with χ = 1 on {g ≤ r} and χ = 0 on {g ≥ s}. Then |∫_G⟨ω, ζ⟩ dν - ∫⟨χω, ζ⟩ dν| ≤ c·ν({r < g < s}). Here ν({r < g < s}) ≤ ν(G) < ∞, and its real value is used.
 Proof of the claim.
 (a) F(x) := ⟨ω(x), ζ(x)⟩ is ν-a.e. strongly measurable: (L, v) ↦ L(v) is jointly continuous (Continuous.clm_apply); x ↦ (ζ(x), ω(x)) is ν-a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable.prodMk, ω continuous); and continuous maps preserve a.e. strong measurability (Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable).
 (b) For ν-a.e. x, |F(x)| ≤ |ω(x)| ≤ c (hypothesis with α := ω(x), and step 1). Also |χ(x)F(x)| ≤ c, since 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1.
 (c) Since ν(G) < ∞, F and χF are integrable on G (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded).
 (d) ⟨χ(x)ω(x), ζ(x)⟩ = χ(x)F(x) by linearity of ζ(x) (map_smul). χF vanishes outside G, where g ≥ s and so χ = 0. Hence ∫χF dν = ∫_G χF dν (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero).
 (e) By (c) and linearity, ∫_G F dν - ∫_G χF dν = ∫_G (1 - χ)F dν (integral_sub).
 (f) (1 - χ)F vanishes on G ∖ {r < g < s} = G ∩ {g ≤ r}, where χ = 1. Since {r < g < s} ⊆ G and G is Borel, ∫_G (1 - χ)F dν = ∫_{r<g<s} (1 - χ)F dν (setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero).
 (g) |(1 - χ)F| ≤ c ν-a.e., because 0 ≤ 1 - χ ≤ 1 and by (b). Since ν({r < g < s}) ≤ ν(G) < ∞, |∫_{r<g<s} (1 - χ)F dν| ≤ c·ν({r < g < s}) (norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const_ae).
 Combining (d)-(g) proves the claim.
3. Fix ε > 0 and put η := ε/(3(c + 1)) > 0.
4. (Small layer for the limit measure.) For i ∈ ℕ let S_i := {s - 1/(i+1) < g < s}.
 - Each S_i is Borel, since g is continuous.
 - The sequence is decreasing: 1/(k+1) ≤ 1/(i+1) for i ≤ k.
 - μ(S_0) ≤ μ(G) < ∞.
 - ⋂_i S_i = ∅: if g(x) < s, choose i with 1/(i+1) < s - g(x) (exists_nat_one_div_lt), so x ∉ S_i; if g(x) ≥ s, then x ∉ S_0.
 By continuity from above (tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop), μ(S_i) → μ(∅) = 0. So some i has μ(S_i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η. Put δ₁ := 1/(i+1) > 0; then μ({s - δ₁ < g < s}) ≤ η.
5. (Small layer along the sequence.) Apply (H6) with ε := ENNReal.ofReal η > 0. This gives δ₂ > 0 and N₂ with μ_j({s - δ₂ ≤ g ≤ s}) ≤ η for all j ≥ N₂.
6. (Cutoff.) Let δ' := min(δ₁, δ₂) > 0. The set {g ≤ s - δ'} is closed and contained in the open set {g < s - δ'/2}, which is its own interior. By the smooth Urysohn lemma there is a C^∞ function χ : ℝ^P → [0, 1] with χ = 1 on {g ≤ s - δ'} and χ = 0 outside {g < s - δ'/2}; in particular χ = 0 on {g ≥ s}. (Mathlib: exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior with the model modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ^P and n = ∞, followed by contMDiff_iff_contDiff.)
7. (The test form χω.) The form χω : x ↦ χ(x)ω(x) is C^∞ (ContDiff.smul). Its support is contained in that of ω, since ω(x) = 0 implies χ(x)ω(x) = 0. So it has compact support (HasCompactSupport.mono'), and tsupport(χω) ⊆ tsupport(ω) ⊆ U (closure_mono). Hence χω ∈ 𝒟^d(U).
8. By (H5) applied to χω there is N₁ with |T_j(χω) - T(χω)| < η for all j ≥ N₁.
9. (Estimate.) Let j ≥ max(N₁, N₂).
 - By (H4), T'_j(ω) = ∫_G⟨ω, ξ_j⟩ dμ_j and T_j(χω) = ∫⟨χω, ξ_j⟩ dμ_j. Step 2 with ν := μ_j, ζ := ξ_j, r := s - δ' applies, by (H1)-(H3) and step 6. Using δ' ≤ δ₂ and step 5, |T'_j(ω) - T_j(χω)| ≤ c·μ_j({s - δ' < g < s}) ≤ c·μ_j({s - δ₂ ≤ g ≤ s}) ≤ cη.
 - Likewise, step 2 with ν := μ and ζ := ξ, together with δ' ≤ δ₁ and step 4, gives |T'(ω) - T(χω)| ≤ c·μ({s - δ' < g < s}) ≤ c·μ({s - δ₁ < g < s}) ≤ cη.
 The passage from the ENNReal bounds to real bounds uses ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal.
10. By the triangle inequality, for all j ≥ max(N₁, N₂), |T'_j(ω) - T'(ω)| ≤ |T'_j(ω) - T_j(χω)| + |T_j(χω) - T(χω)| + |T(χω) - T'(ω)| < cη + η + cη = (2c + 1)η < 3(c + 1)η = ε.
11. Since ε > 0 was arbitrary, T'_j(ω) → T'(ω). Since ω was arbitrary, T'_j ⇀ T' (WeaklyConvergesOn). ∎
Formalization notes, from the compiled proof below:
- Do not open scoped ContDiff: it makes ω a token, which breaks binder names. Write the smoothness order as ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞).
- Use modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (Euclid P) instead of the 𝓘 notation.
- Build χω from pointwise support inclusions (HasCompactSupport.mono', closure_mono). The generic HasCompactSupport.smul_left and tsupport_smul_subset_right took several minutes to elaborate for covector-valued forms.

  intro P d U g s μs μ ξs ξ Ts Ts' T T' hg hμsG hμG hξsm hξm hξsb hξb hTs hT hTs' hT' hconv hconc
  intro ω
  obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d, w = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwc : Continuous w := by rw [hwdef]; exact ω.property.1.1.continuous
  -- Step 1: a bound `c` for the coefficient norm of `ω`.
  have hnc : Continuous fun α : Covector (Euclid P) d => covectorEuclideanNorm α := by
    unfold covectorEuclideanNorm
    apply Continuous.sqrt
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro I _
    split_ifs
    · exact (continuous_eval_const _).pow 2
    · exact continuous_const
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (w x) ≤ c := by
    have hwcs : HasCompactSupport w := by
      rw [hwdef]
      exact ω.property.1.2
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport (covectorEuclideanNorm ∘ w) :=
      hwcs.comp_left (covectorEuclideanNorm_zero P d)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcs.exists_bound_of_continuous (hnc.comp hwc)
    exact ⟨C, fun x => le_trans (le_abs_self _) (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC x)⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := le_trans (covectorEuclideanNorm_nonneg _) (hc 0)
  have hGm : MeasurableSet {x | g x < s} := measurableSet_lt hg.measurable measurable_const
  -- Step 2: the cutoff estimate, for an arbitrary measure.
  have key : ∀ (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (χ : Euclid P → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
      ν {x | g x < s} < ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ ν →
      (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) →
      Continuous χ → (∀ x, χ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → (∀ x, g x ≤ r → χ x = 1) →
      (∀ x, s ≤ g x → χ x = 0) →
      |∫ x in {x | g x < s}, ζ x (w x) ∂ν - ∫ x, ζ x (χ x • w x) ∂ν| ≤
        c * ν.real {x | r < g x ∧ g x < s} := by
    intro ν ζ χ r hνG hζm hζb hχc hχ01 hχ1 hχ0
    have hF : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ζ x (w x)) ν :=
      (continuous_fst.clm_apply continuous_snd).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        (hζm.prodMk hwc.aestronglyMeasurable)
    have hFb : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, |ζ x (w x)| ≤ c := hζb.mono fun x hx => (hx _).trans (hc x)
    have hint1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => ζ x (w x)) {x | g x < s} ν :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hνG.ne hF
        (ae_restrict_of_ae (hFb.mono fun x hx => by rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs]))
    have hχF : ∀ x, |ζ x (w x)| ≤ c → |χ x * ζ x (w x)| ≤ c := by
      intro x hx
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h01 := hχ01 x
      calc |χ x| * |ζ x (w x)| ≤ 1 * c :=
            mul_le_mul (by rw [abs_of_nonneg h01.1]; exact h01.2) hx (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = c := one_mul c
    have hint2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => χ x * ζ x (w x)) {x | g x < s} ν :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hνG.ne (hχc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hF)
        (ae_restrict_of_ae (hFb.mono fun x hx => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hχF x hx))
    have hsmul : ∀ x, ζ x (χ x • w x) = χ x * ζ x (w x) := fun x => by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have h2 : ∫ x, ζ x (χ x • w x) ∂ν = ∫ x in {x | g x < s}, χ x * ζ x (w x) ∂ν := by
      simp_rw [hsmul]
      exact (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero fun x hx => by
        have : s ≤ g x := not_lt.1 hx
        rw [hχ0 x this, zero_mul]).symm
    rw [h2, ← integral_sub hint1 hint2]
    have h3 : ∫ x in {x | g x < s}, (ζ x (w x) - χ x * ζ x (w x)) ∂ν =
        ∫ x in {x | r < g x ∧ g x < s}, (ζ x (w x) - χ x * ζ x (w x)) ∂ν := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero hGm (fun x hx => hx.2)
      intro x hx
      have : g x ≤ r := by
        by_contra h
        exact hx.2 ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, hx.1⟩
      rw [hχ1 x this]
      ring
    rw [h3, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const_ae
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono fun x hx => hx.2) hνG)
    apply ae_restrict_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hFb] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, show ζ x (w x) - χ x * ζ x (w x) = (1 - χ x) * ζ x (w x) by ring,
      abs_mul]
    have h01 := hχ01 x
    calc |1 - χ x| * |ζ x (w x)| ≤ 1 * c :=
          mul_le_mul (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [h01.2])]; linarith [h01.1]) hx
            (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = c := one_mul c

      ∃ δ₁ : ℝ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ μ {x | s - δ₁ < g x ∧ g x < s} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η := by

  have hws : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) w := by rw [hwdef]; exact ω.property.1.1
  have hwcs : HasCompactSupport w := by rw [hwdef]; exact ω.property.1.2

  have h2 : HasCompactSupport (fun x => χ x • w x) :=
    hwcs.mono' (hsupp.trans (subset_tsupport w))

  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hconvχ

  have hm1 : (μs j).real {x | s - min δ₁ δ₂ < g x ∧ g x < s} ≤ η := by

          fun x hx => ⟨by linarith [hx.1, min_le_right δ₁ δ₂], hx.2.le⟩)) (hN₂ j hj₂)
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hη.le this
  have hm2 : μ.real {x | s - min δ₁ δ₂ < g x ∧ g x < s} ≤ η := by

    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hη.le this
  have h3 : dist (Ts j χω) (T χω) < η := hN₁ j hj₁
  have hTsχ : Ts j χω = ∫ x, ξs j x (χ x • w x) ∂(μs j) := hTs j χω

proof_key_steps: Bound |ω(x)| ≤ c, using that the coefficient norm of ω is continuous and compactly supported.
Cutoff estimate: |∫_G⟨ω,ζ⟩dν - ∫⟨χω,ζ⟩dν| ≤ c·ν({r < g < s}) for continuous χ ∈ [0,1] with χ = 1 on {g ≤ r} and χ = 0 on {g ≥ s}.

Triangle inequality: |T'_j(ω) - T'(ω)| ≤ (2c+1)η < ε for large j, so T'_j ⇀ T'.
